compatibilityIssues: Migration from Web Forms to .NET 8 required
upgradeSteps: Refactor Web Forms to Razor Pages/MVC

issues.impact: All data access code must be rewritten. DbContext configuration, entity mappings, and LINQ queries require significant modifications.
issues.description: The application uses Entity Framework 6.2.0 which is NOT compatible with .NET 8. EF6 is a .NET Framework-only library and must be replaced with Entity Framework Core 8.0.0.
issues.recommendation: Migrate to Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore 8.0.0, Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.SqlServer 8.0.0, and Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Design 8.0.0. Update DbContext to inherit from Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.DbContext. Convert all entity configurations to use IEntityTypeConfiguration<T>. Replace Database.SetInitializer with migrations. Update all LINQ queries for EF Core compatibility.
issues.title: Entity Framework 6.2.0 Not Compatible with .NET 8

issues.impact: All logging code (19 files) must be updated to use ILogger<T> instead of ILog from log4net.
issues.description: The application uses log4net 2.0.10 which is a legacy logging framework not recommended for .NET 8 applications.
issues.recommendation: Replace log4net with Microsoft.Extensions.Logging 8.0.0 and Serilog.AspNetCore 8.0.0. Replace all ILog references with ILogger<T>. Update logging statements to use structured logging. Configure logging in Program.cs. Remove log4Net.xml configuration file.
issues.title: log4net Not Recommended for .NET 8

issues.codeSnippet: using System.Web; using System.Web.UI; using System.Web.Optimization;
issues.impact: Complete rewrite of UI layer required. All 8 Web Forms pages must be converted to Razor Pages or MVC views.
issues.description: The application has 87 System.Web references across 29 files. System.Web is not available in .NET 8 as it's .NET Framework-only.
issues.recommendation: Replace System.Web.UI.Page with PageModel (Razor Pages) or Controller (MVC). Replace HttpContext.Current with IHttpContextAccessor. Replace Server.MapPath with IWebHostEnvironment. Replace Session with distributed cache or TempData. Replace Cache with IMemoryCache or IDistributedCache.
issues.title: System.Web Dependencies Throughout Application

issues.codeSnippet: protected void Application_Start(object sender, EventArgs e)
issues.impact: Application startup and configuration must be completely redesigned for ASP.NET Core.
issues.description: Global.asax.cs contains application startup logic including Autofac container configuration, database initialization, and session management that needs migration to ASP.NET Core.
issues.recommendation: Migrate Global.asax logic to Program.cs and use middleware pipeline. Convert Autofac registration to built-in DI container. Move database initialization to Program.cs startup. Replace Session_Start with session middleware configuration.
issues.title: Global.asax Application Startup Pattern

issues.impact: All configuration must be migrated to JSON format and accessed via IConfiguration.
issues.description: Application uses Web.config for configuration which must be replaced with appsettings.json for .NET 8.
issues.recommendation: Create appsettings.json and appsettings.Development.json. Migrate connection strings to appsettings.json. Migrate appSettings to appsettings.json. Remove entityFramework section (use EF Core). Remove system.web and system.webServer sections. Configure middleware in Program.cs instead of httpModules.
issues.title: Web.config Configuration File

issues.impact: Dependency injection configuration must be rewritten. IContainerProviderAccessor pattern must be replaced.
issues.description: Application uses Autofac 4.9.1 and Autofac.Web 4.0.0 for dependency injection. While Autofac can work with .NET 8, the built-in DI container is recommended.
issues.recommendation: Migrate to built-in ASP.NET Core DI container. Register services in Program.cs using builder.Services.AddScoped/AddTransient/AddSingleton. Remove Autofac.Integration.Web dependencies. Update service registration in ApplicationModule.cs to use IServiceCollection extension methods.
issues.title: Autofac 4.9.1 Third-Party DI Container

issues.impact: All session state access patterns must be rewritten.
issues.description: Application uses HttpContext.Current for accessing session and request information, which is not available in ASP.NET Core.
issues.recommendation: Replace HttpContext.Current with IHttpContextAccessor injected via DI. Use HttpContextAccessor.HttpContext to access current context. Configure session using AddSession() and UseSession() middleware. Consider using TempData or distributed cache instead of session state.
issues.title: HttpContext.Current Usage

issues.codeSnippet: protected void Page_Load(object sender, EventArgs e)
issues.impact: Complete rewrite of page event handling logic for all 8 pages.
issues.description: All 10 Web Forms pages use Page_Load event which doesn't exist in Razor Pages or MVC.
issues.recommendation: Convert to Razor Pages OnGet/OnPost handlers or MVC Controller actions. Move data loading logic to OnGetAsync() handlers. Replace postback event handlers with form post handlers. Remove ViewState dependencies and use model binding instead.
issues.title: Page Lifecycle Events (Page_Load)

issues.impact: All 8 ASPX pages must be converted to Razor syntax with HTML and Tag Helpers.
issues.description: Application uses ASP.NET server controls (ListView, HyperLink, asp:Content, etc.) throughout pages which have no equivalent in .NET 8.
issues.recommendation: Replace asp:ListView with HTML table or modern component (e.g., Blazor component, React/Vue table). Replace asp:HyperLink with HTML anchor tags with asp-route tag helpers. Replace asp:Content with @section in Razor Pages. Use Tag Helpers for form elements instead of server controls.
issues.title: ASP.NET Web Forms Server Controls

issues.impact: Layout structure must be redesigned for Razor Pages architecture.
issues.description: Application uses Site.Master for layout which must be converted to _Layout.cshtml in Razor Pages.
issues.recommendation: Create Pages/Shared/_Layout.cshtml to replace master page. Convert asp:ContentPlaceHolder to @RenderBody() and @RenderSection(). Move master page code-behind logic to _ViewStart.cshtml or page models. Update all pages to use layout page instead of MasterPageFile directive.
issues.title: Master Page Pattern

issues.impact: User control pattern must be replaced with modern component pattern.
issues.description: Application has ViewSwitcher.ascx user control which must be converted to Partial View or View Component.
issues.recommendation: Convert to Partial View (_ViewSwitcher.cshtml) or View Component. Remove code-behind and move logic to view model or helper methods. Replace with @await Html.PartialAsync() or @await Component.InvokeAsync().
issues.title: ViewSwitcher User Control

issues.impact: URL routing, session management, and bundling must be reimplemented with ASP.NET Core equivalents.
issues.description: Multiple Microsoft.AspNet.* packages (FriendlyUrls, SessionState.SessionStateModule, TelemetryCorrelation, Web.Optimization) are .NET Framework-only.
issues.recommendation: Remove Microsoft.AspNet.FriendlyUrls (use endpoint routing). Replace SessionStateModule with ASP.NET Core session middleware. Replace TelemetryCorrelation with Application Insights for ASP.NET Core. Remove Web.Optimization (use wwwroot and bundling/minification tools like WebOptimizer or Webpack).
issues.title: Microsoft.AspNet.* Packages Not Compatible

issues.impact: Client-side script management must be redesigned.
issues.description: Site.Master uses asp:ScriptManager with Web Forms-specific scripts that don't exist in .NET 8.
issues.recommendation: Remove ScriptManager. Include JavaScript files directly in layout using <script> tags. Replace Web Forms validation scripts with client-side validation libraries (jQuery Validation or FluentValidation.AspNetCore). Remove MSAjax and Web Forms bundle references.
issues.title: ScriptManager and Web Forms Scripts

issues.impact: All entity configurations and database initialization logic must be rewritten for EF Core.
issues.description: CatalogDBContext uses EF6 DbContext with EntityTypeConfiguration which has different syntax in EF Core.
issues.recommendation: Update to Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.DbContext. Replace EntityTypeConfiguration<T> with IEntityTypeConfiguration<T>. Replace HasRequired/WithMany with HasOne/WithMany. Update DbSet configuration syntax. Replace Database.SetInitializer with migrations using dotnet ef migrations.
issues.title: Entity Framework 6 DbContext Pattern

issues.impact: All service methods must be converted to async/await pattern.
issues.description: CatalogService uses synchronous EF6 methods (ToList(), SaveChanges()) which should be async in .NET 8.
issues.recommendation: Convert all database operations to async. Replace LongCount() with LongCountAsync(). Replace ToList() with ToListAsync(). Replace SaveChanges() with SaveChangesAsync(). Add CancellationToken parameters. Update interface methods to return Task<T>.
issues.title: Synchronous Database Operations

issues.impact: All routing configuration must be migrated to ASP.NET Core routing system.
issues.description: Application uses System.Web.Routing.RouteTable which doesn't exist in ASP.NET Core.
issues.recommendation: Replace with ASP.NET Core endpoint routing. Configure routes in Program.cs using app.MapRazorPages() or app.MapControllerRoute(). Use attribute routing with [Route] attributes. Replace GetRouteUrl() with IUrlHelper.RouteUrl() or Url.Page().
issues.title: RouteConfig Using Web Forms Routing

issues.impact: Asset bundling and optimization must be replaced with modern approach.
issues.description: BundleConfig.cs uses System.Web.Optimization.BundleTable which is .NET Framework-only.
issues.recommendation: Remove BundleConfig. Place static files (CSS, JS) in wwwroot folder. Use <link> and <script> tags in _Layout.cshtml. Consider using WebOptimizer NuGet package for bundling/minification or modern build tools (Webpack, Vite). Use environment tag helpers for dev/production scripts.
issues.title: BundleConfig Using System.Web.Optimization

issues.impact: ID generation strategy may need redesign depending on chosen approach.
issues.description: CatalogItemHiLoGenerator uses custom ID generation with raw SQL which needs to be adapted for EF Core.
issues.recommendation: Either migrate HiLo generator to EF Core format using FromSqlRaw/FromSqlInterpolated, or switch to database-generated IDs using Identity specification in EF Core configuration. Consider using EF Core's built-in HiLo support with UseHiLo() in SQL Server provider.
issues.title: HiLo ID Generation Pattern

issues.impact: New authentication system must be designed and implemented.
issues.description: Application has no authentication or authorization visible in code, which needs to be implemented in .NET 8.
issues.recommendation: Implement ASP.NET Core Identity using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Identity.EntityFrameworkCore. Create IdentityDbContext. Configure authentication and authorization in Program.cs. Add [Authorize] attributes to protected pages. Implement login/logout pages. Configure cookie authentication or JWT.
issues.title: No Authentication/Authorization Implementation

issues.codeSnippet: protected void Create_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
issues.impact: All button click handlers must be converted to page handler methods.
issues.description: Create.aspx.cs uses postback event handler Create_Click which doesn't exist in Razor Pages.
issues.recommendation: Convert to Razor Pages OnPostAsync() handler method. Use [BindProperty] for form data binding. Replace ModelState.IsValid check with model validation. Replace Response.Redirect with RedirectToPage(). Use TempData for success messages.
issues.title: Postback Event Handlers

issues.impact: Data binding pattern must be adapted to Razor Pages model.
issues.description: Create.aspx.cs uses GetBrands() and GetTypes() methods for data binding which is Web Forms-specific pattern.
issues.recommendation: Move data loading to OnGetAsync() method in page model. Assign to public properties for view access. Use [BindProperty] or ViewData for passing data to view. Replace with select tag helpers and data passed via model.
issues.title: Data Binding with GetBrands/GetTypes Methods

issues.impact: All dependency injection must be converted to constructor injection pattern.
issues.description: Pages use property injection (CatalogService property) via Autofac which is Web Forms-specific.
issues.recommendation: Convert to constructor injection in page models. Define private readonly fields. Inject services in PageModel constructor. Remove Autofac property injection module.
issues.title: Property Injection via Autofac

issues.impact: Project structure should be reorganized for better maintainability.
issues.description: Application mixes concerns with Models, Services, and ViewModel folders in single project without clear layer separation.
issues.recommendation: Implement clean architecture with separate projects: Domain (entities, interfaces), Application (services, DTOs, validators), Infrastructure (repositories, DbContext), and Web (Razor Pages, ViewModels). Apply dependency inversion principle. Use CQRS pattern if needed.
issues.title: No Clean Architecture Separation

issues.impact: Recommended for better testability and separation of concerns.
issues.description: CatalogService directly uses DbContext instead of repository abstraction.
issues.recommendation: Implement repository pattern with ICatalogItemRepository, ICatalogBrandRepository, ICatalogTypeRepository. Create repository implementations in Infrastructure layer. Inject repositories into service layer. Apply Unit of Work pattern if needed.
issues.title: No Repository Pattern

issues.impact: Test infrastructure should be established for quality assurance.
issues.description: No test projects found in solution.
issues.recommendation: Create test projects: [ProjectName].UnitTests and [ProjectName].IntegrationTests. Use xUnit as testing framework. Add FluentAssertions for assertions. Add Moq for mocking. Implement tests for services, repositories, and page handlers. Aim for 80% code coverage.
issues.title: No Unit Tests or Integration Tests

issues.impact: Validation logic should be enhanced for production readiness.
issues.description: Application relies on ModelState validation with limited validation attributes on entities.
issues.recommendation: Implement FluentValidation with validators for DTOs. Add comprehensive validation rules (required, length, range, regex). Create custom validators for business rules. Configure validation in Program.cs. Use validation tag helpers in views.
issues.title: Limited Input Validation

issues.impact: Configuration access pattern must be updated throughout application.
issues.description: Global.asax.cs uses ConfigurationManager.AppSettings which should be replaced with IConfiguration.
issues.recommendation: Replace ConfigurationManager with IConfiguration injected via DI. Access settings using configuration["UseMockData"]. Use Options pattern with IOptions<T> for strongly-typed configuration. Create configuration classes for different sections.
issues.title: ConfigurationManager Usage

issues.impact: Telemetry configuration needs updating but functionality remains similar.
issues.description: Application uses Microsoft.ApplicationInsights 2.9.1 which is outdated for .NET 8.
issues.recommendation: Upgrade to Microsoft.ApplicationInsights.AspNetCore 2.22.0 or later. Remove Web-specific Application Insights packages. Configure in Program.cs using builder.Services.AddApplicationInsightsTelemetry(). Update ApplicationInsights.config to use code-based configuration.
issues.title: Application Insights 2.9.1 Outdated

issues.impact: JSON serialization code may need minor adjustments.
issues.description: Application uses Newtonsoft.Json 12.0.1. While compatible, System.Text.Json is preferred in .NET 8.
issues.recommendation: Migrate to System.Text.Json which is built into .NET 8. Update serialization code to use JsonSerializer from System.Text.Json. Configure JSON options in Program.cs. Handle differences in serialization behavior (camelCase, null handling, etc.).
issues.title: Newtonsoft.Json Should Be System.Text.Json

issues.impact: Additional layer of abstraction improves security and maintainability.
issues.description: Application appears to bind entities directly to views without Data Transfer Objects.
issues.recommendation: Create DTOs in Application layer (CatalogItemDto, CatalogItemCreateDto, CatalogItemUpdateDto). Use AutoMapper to map between entities and DTOs. Never expose entities directly to UI layer. Create ViewModels in Web layer for page-specific display data.
issues.title: No DTOs - Direct Entity Binding

issues.impact: Robust error handling is critical for production applications.
issues.description: No global error handling or exception middleware visible in code.
issues.recommendation: Implement global exception handling middleware. Add try-catch blocks in service layer with proper logging. Create custom exception types (NotFoundException, ValidationException). Configure developer exception page for development. Implement error pages for production. Use ProblemDetails for API responses.
issues.title: Limited Error Handling

issues.impact: Database initialization and seeding logic must be rewritten.
issues.description: CatalogDBInitializer uses EF6 Database.SetInitializer which doesn't exist in EF Core.
issues.recommendation: Replace with EF Core migrations. Create initial migration using dotnet ef migrations add InitialCreate. Seed data in OnModelCreating using modelBuilder.Entity<T>().HasData(). Apply migrations at startup using context.Database.Migrate() in Program.cs. Remove database initializer classes.
issues.title: Database Initializer Pattern

issues.impact: Logging context management must be adapted to new logging framework.
issues.description: Global.asax.cs uses log4net's LogicalThreadContext which won't work with Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.
issues.recommendation: Replace with ILogger scopes using using (logger.BeginScope(new Dictionary<string, object> {{ "ActivityId", activityId }}). Use Activity.Current for distributed tracing. Configure Serilog enrichers if needed. Remove LogicalThreadContext pattern.
issues.title: log4net LogicalThreadContext Usage

issues.impact: Navigation code must be updated throughout application.
issues.description: Pages use Response.Redirect which should be replaced with RedirectToPage or RedirectToAction.
issues.recommendation: Replace with return RedirectToPage("/Index") in Razor Pages or return RedirectToAction() in MVC. Use RedirectToPage with route parameters for navigation. Use TempData for passing success messages between pages.
issues.title: Response.Redirect Usage

issues.impact: Better separation of concerns between layers.
issues.description: PaginatedItemsViewModel is used across service and UI layers without proper separation.
issues.recommendation: Create PaginatedResult<T> in Application layer as DTO. Create separate PaginatedViewModel<T> in Web layer. Map from PaginatedResult to PaginatedViewModel in page handlers. Keep ViewModels exclusively in Web layer.
issues.title: PaginatedItemsViewModel in Wrong Layer

issues.impact: Audit trail is important for production applications.
issues.description: Service layer doesn't track created/modified metadata (CreatedDate, ModifiedDate, CreatedBy, ModifiedBy).
issues.recommendation: Add audit fields (CreatedDate, ModifiedDate, CreatedBy, ModifiedBy, IsActive) to all entities. Implement SaveChanges override in DbContext to automatically set these fields. Use IHttpContextAccessor to get current user. Apply audit fields consistently.
issues.title: No Tracking of Entity Changes

issues.impact: Minor CSS and JavaScript updates required.
issues.description: Application uses Bootstrap 4.3.1 which is outdated. Bootstrap 5 is recommended for modern applications.
issues.recommendation: Upgrade to Bootstrap 5.3.x. Place Bootstrap files in wwwroot/lib/bootstrap. Update HTML classes (data-toggle to data-bs-toggle, etc.). Remove jQuery dependency if possible (Bootstrap 5 doesn't require jQuery). Test responsive layouts.
issues.title: Bootstrap 4.3.1 Outdated

issues.impact: Minimal impact - mostly version update.
issues.description: Application uses jQuery 3.5.0. Consider upgrading or removing if not needed.
issues.recommendation: Upgrade to jQuery 3.7.x or consider removing if using modern framework (Blazor, React, Vue). For Razor Pages, jQuery may still be useful for client-side validation. Place in wwwroot/lib/jquery if keeping.
issues.title: jQuery 3.5.0 Outdated

issues.impact: Responsive design replaces separate mobile layout.
issues.description: Application has Site.Mobile.Master for mobile devices which is Web Forms-specific.
issues.recommendation: Remove mobile master page. Use responsive design with CSS media queries in single layout. Implement responsive Bootstrap grid system. Consider progressive web app (PWA) for mobile experience. Use viewport meta tag for mobile optimization.
issues.title: Mobile Master Page

issues.impact: Project file becomes much simpler and maintainable.
issues.description: Project uses old-style .csproj with explicit file listings instead of SDK-style project.
issues.recommendation: Convert to SDK-style project format. Use <Project Sdk="Microsoft.NET.Sdk.Web">. Set TargetFramework to net8.0. Remove explicit file listings (uses glob patterns). Simplify package references. Enable nullable reference types and implicit usings.
issues.title: Old-Style .csproj Format

issues.impact: Clean up unused or properly utilize mock implementation.
issues.description: CatalogServiceMock exists for testing but no actual tests found.
issues.recommendation: Either implement proper unit tests using mock service or remove it. If keeping, use for development with in-memory data. Better approach is using InMemory database provider for EF Core in tests.
issues.title: Mock Service Implementation

issues.impact: Security is improved by default in ASP.NET Core.
issues.description: Web.config has requestValidationMode="2.0" which is less secure.
issues.recommendation: In ASP.NET Core, request validation is automatic. Ensure anti-XSS measures are in place. Use data annotations for validation. Enable CORS properly. Use Content Security Policy headers. Sanitize user input.
issues.title: Request Validation Disabled

issues.impact: Cleaner service design with DI managing lifetimes.
issues.description: ICatalogService implements IDisposable which shouldn't be needed with DI container managing lifetime.
issues.recommendation: Remove IDisposable from service interface. Let DI container manage DbContext lifetime. Use scoped lifetime for DbContext. DI container will handle disposal automatically. Only implement IDisposable for unmanaged resources.
issues.title: IDisposable Implementation on Service

issues.impact: Improved code readability and maintainability.
issues.description: Mixed naming conventions (eShopLegacyWebForms vs CatalogService).
issues.recommendation: Adopt consistent naming: [CompanyName].[ProjectName].[Layer] for projects. PascalCase for classes, interfaces, methods. camelCase for parameters, local variables. Use descriptive names (CatalogManagement instead of eShopLegacyWebForms).
issues.title: Inconsistent Naming Convention

issues.impact: Optional enhancement for extensibility.
issues.description: Application is pure Web Forms with no API endpoints for external access.
issues.recommendation: Consider adding API controllers for external access. Implement RESTful API with [ApiController] and endpoints. Use same services and repositories. Add Swagger/OpenAPI documentation. Support JSON responses. Consider separation of Web and API projects.
issues.title: No API/Controller Layer

issues.impact: Performance optimization for production.
issues.description: Application has no caching for frequently accessed data (brands, types).
issues.recommendation: Implement IMemoryCache for reference data (brands, types). Add distributed caching (Redis) for scalability. Cache catalog items with expiration. Use cache-aside pattern. Implement cache invalidation on updates. Add response caching for GET endpoints.
issues.title: No Caching Implementation

issues.impact: Important for production monitoring and orchestration.
issues.description: No health check endpoints for monitoring application status.
issues.recommendation: Add health check endpoints using AddHealthChecks(). Include database health check. Include custom health checks for critical dependencies. Expose /health and /health/ready endpoints. Configure health check UI if needed.
issues.title: Limited Health Checks

recommendations: Migrate Entity Framework 6 to EF Core 8 first as this is a foundational change affecting all data access.
Replace log4net with Microsoft.Extensions.Logging/Serilog to enable proper .NET 8 logging infrastructure.
Implement clean architecture with separate Domain, Application, Infrastructure, and Web projects before migrating pages.
Convert all 7 ASPX pages to Razor Pages with proper page models and handlers. Start with simplest pages (About, Contact) then move to complex CRUD pages.
Migrate Web.config to appsettings.json and move Global.asax logic to Program.cs.
Replace Autofac with built-in ASP.NET Core DI container and convert to constructor injection.
Implement repository pattern and convert all database operations to async/await.
Create test infrastructure with unit and integration tests achieving 80% coverage.
Implement ASP.NET Core Identity for authentication and authorization.
Upgrade Bootstrap to version 5 and implement responsive design without separate mobile layout.
Add caching, health checks, and comprehensive error handling for production readiness.
